method: Source face alpha>=128 mapped with exact Idle face affine. Selected art main crown/chin/neck visually identified in source pixels; excludes bun and ribbons. Approximate crown/chin location, no raster edit. Geometry units are source model pixels before common scale.
recommendation: Scale selected head around fixed neck by1.25–1.30 as moderate first correction. Source face core alone is not exactly comparable to full cranium/skin head; do not force exact ratio solely from source. Preserve body and limb geometry.
